nodes.statement: YES. Three uses: hour-class tricks into notrest; two patterns (async-approval-via-simulation, code-enforced child allowlists); and the product path — Not Rest OS: their chassis (multi-user workspace, gadget sandbox globalOutbound:null, 16 connectors, web UI) + our discipline layer (trail/receipts/continuation, refuter+eval+doctor verification, decomposition gauge, spend audit, deterministic renders) = the differentiated thesis: the honest company OS. A static check that keys on the law's own recital words turns the recital into a licence: key exemptions on a declaration shape, not vocabulary. A guard with no red-first fixture arm is vacuous: revert it and the suite stays green.

A grammar check over model directives can decide shape, never whether a tier was deserved; the law string states that bound and the seat's judgment plus the spend receipt carry the semantics. Do not widen the regex toward subject matter.
When a check asks whether a PATH is present, use lexists, not exists: exists follows symlinks and reads a dangling link as absence, which let an unlisted surface hide behind a fake deletion.

Never resolve an ambiguous ask from what the estate already contains; ask the owner the FORM of a deliverable before building, and a release needs its own explicit ask every time. Disclosing a default in a progress report is not consent.

A trigger tag quoted inside a ledger line fires the trigger when the headline is unbounded: every seat line carries an early '->' separator, the headline is capped to its first 120 chars, and tag words are never quoted before the arrow.
Card banking in agent-ledger.sh was gated on its fixture, not on a real lane return; no COORD-AGENTS row has yet shown a banked card.

The CLI's shared 1.5 s SessionEnd budget for PLUGIN hooks (declared timeout ignored) was read off the 2.1.237 binary by the refuter and has never been observed live; session-end.sh was made stdin-free on that reading.

Fresh-session auto-continuation probe verified at the consumer: a headless session in this folder named version 4.6.2, HEAD 21aa5f8, the newest ledger line and the newest ship from the packet alone, planned a tier-0 verify, read no files.

Unattended BLOCKED path verified live on this estate at zero spend: auto-run with the real runner stopped on auth, wrote pulse/auto-run.status BLOCKED, receipted tokens=0, and a real session-start printed the unattended-compile banner line.

A trigger's headline is the text before the arrow with no character cap; a flat 120-char cap blinded the correction regex on 43 percent of well-formed ledger lines. The cap applies only to arrowless lines, and tag words are never quoted before the arrow.
supersedes L-5 — replaced by L-6. the 120-char cap was wrong: the arrow bounds the headline; the cap applies to arrowless lines only (refuter D2)

Harvested prompt text must honor fences and carry provenance; worker-authored records are proposals until the seat accepts them; pair a lane to its gates by an explicit key, not a content hash; a self-writing estate filters its own machinery lines at every reader.

The per-run token cap is enforced after the headless run ends, not during it: one build spent 1,409,130 tokens against a 400,000 cap and was marked CAPPED post hoc; only the daily cap refused the next run.

A cap checked when the run ends is accounting, not a limit: the first unattended build overran its 400k run cap 3.5x before the check ran. A limit must act inside the run it bounds, and its arm must show the run stopped, not recorded.

A cached verdict not bound to the content it vouches for is not a gate, and a fast path that reimplements a verifier is a second authority that will disagree with the first; call the one verifier and pay the start-up cost.

Delegating a verdict moves the trust boundary to the delegate's inputs: the ring it reads, the interpreter that runs it, the path it is found at. Pin all three (a fixed ring, a sentinel the caller checks, an absolute path) or the delegate is the new weakest link.
Hardening that only a fixture exercises is invisible to the law suite: every guard clause gets an arm in the eval check that grades the gate, not only in the hook fixture, or a revert ships green.

A release stamp must never be a blind global substitution: a pinned tombstone shares the old version string and gets bumped by the same sed. Stamp scripts name the entries they touch and assert the pins afterwards.
